displayPattern: 7-segment display on an American Standard S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace: E04
meaning: Open limit: the main thermal limit, a rollout switch, or the reverse airflow switch.
diySteps: If you see scorching at the burners, or you smell hot metal or combustion odor, turn the furnace off and leave it off
The heating sequence proves the rollout switches, the main thermal limit and any reverse-airflow switch closed before the inducer starts
Technician: find which of those switches is open before any manual reset
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. E04 names three different safety switches. Do not jumper a limit or reset a rollout switch to finish the night.
